  director = 'Jon Watts',

  tagline = 'The multiverse unleashed.',
  description = 'With Spider-Man''s identity now revealed, Peter asks Doctor Strange for help. When a spell goes wrong, dangerous foes from other worlds start to appear, forcing Peter to discover what it truly means to be Spider-Man.',

  rtCriticsScore = 93,
  rtAudienceScore = 98,
  verdict = 'hit',
  cardMarketContent = '## No Way Home: The Ultimate Spider-Man Card Event

Spider-Man: No Way Home (2021) is arguably the most significant MCU film for card collectors since Endgame. The return of Tobey Maguire, Andrew Garfield, Willem Dafoe, and Alfred Molina created unprecedented demand for Spider-Man cards across all eras.

### Key Sets

The **2022 Upper Deck Spider-Man: No Way Home** set is one of the most valuable modern MCU sets. Cards featuring all three Spider-Men are the ultimate chase items.

### Market Trends

Tobey Maguire''s return created a massive spike in all Spider-Man card values. Willem Dafoe Green Goblin autos are among the most valuable villain cards in the hobby. Andrew Garfield cards surged alongside his Oscar nomination for Tick, Tick... Boom! Triple Spider-Man cards are grail-level items.',
  keyCards = '- **Tobey Maguire Spider-Man Return Auto** — Legendary return ($10,000+)
- **Andrew Garfield Spider-Man Return Auto** — Amazing comeback ($6,000+)
- **Willem Dafoe Green Goblin Auto** — Iconic villain return ($5,000+)
- **Alfred Molina Doc Ock Auto** — Fan-favorite villain ($3,000+)
- **Tom Holland Spider-Man Auto** — Current Spidey ($4,000+)
- **Triple Spider-Man Auto Card** — Ultimate grail if it exists ($25,000+)
- **Jamie Foxx Electro Auto** — Multiverse villain ($1,500+)',
  content = '## The Multiverse Unleashed

No Way Home is the MCU''s ultimate fan-service masterpiece and one of the greatest superhero films ever made. By bringing back Tobey Maguire, Andrew Garfield, Willem Dafoe, and Alfred Molina alongside Tom Holland, the film delivered on 20 years of Spider-Man cinema in a way nobody thought possible. It''s also a genuinely emotional story about sacrifice and growing up.

## The Legacy

- **Three Spider-Men** — The most anticipated crossover in superhero history, delivered perfectly
- **Willem Dafoe** — Returned as Green Goblin and delivered an even better performance than the original
- **$1.9 Billion** — Third highest-grossing film in MCU history, sixth all-time worldwide
- **Identity Reset** — Peter''s sacrifice erased everyone''s memory of him, resetting his story
- **Multiverse Launch** — Alongside Loki and MoM, established the multiverse as the MCU''s new frontier

## Fun Facts

- Tobey Maguire and Andrew Garfield''s involvement was kept secret despite massive leaks
- Andrew Garfield repeatedly denied being in the film in interviews, becoming a running joke
- Willem Dafoe insisted on doing his own stunts and fight choreography at age 66
- The film earned $260M opening weekend — the third-largest opening in history at the time
- Charlie Cox''s Matt Murdock cameo confirmed Daredevil''s MCU integration

## Viewing Context

No Way Home is the **culmination of the Spider-Man Home trilogy** and requires knowledge of all previous Spider-Man films (Raimi trilogy and Amazing Spider-Man films) for maximum impact. It directly follows Far From Home''s cliffhanger and connects to Doctor Strange in the Multiverse of Madness. The ending resets Peter Parker''s status quo entirely.',
  metaDescription = 'Spider-Man: No Way Home (2021) — $1.9B box office, three Spider-Men, 93% RT, and trading card market analysis for Marvel collectors.',
  keywords = 'Spider-Man No Way Home, MCU Phase 4, Tobey Maguire, Andrew Garfield, Tom Holland, Willem Dafoe, multiverse, trading cards, Marvel cards',
  ebaySearchTerm = 'Upper Deck Spider-Man No Way Home cards autograph',
  faqData = '[{"question":"Is Spider-Man No Way Home on Disney+?","answer":"Spider-Man: No Way Home (2021) is available on Disney+ in most regions. It grossed $1.9 billion worldwide and features the return of Tobey Maguire and Andrew Garfield."},{"question":"How much did No Way Home make?","answer":"No Way Home grossed $1.916 billion worldwide — the third highest-grossing MCU film ever, behind Endgame ($2.8B) and Infinity War ($2.05B). It earned $260M opening weekend."},{"question":"What No Way Home cards are valuable?","answer":"Tobey Maguire return autos ($10,000+) are the top chase. Andrew Garfield autos ($6,000+) surged with his Oscar buzz. Willem Dafoe Green Goblin autos ($5,000+) are iconic villain cards. Any triple Spider-Man card would be a $25,000+ grail."},{"question":"Is Andrew Garfield in No Way Home?","answer":"Yes — both Andrew Garfield and Tobey Maguire return as their respective Spider-Men through the multiverse, fighting alongside Tom Holland against villains from all three Spider-Man franchises."},{"question":"What happens at the end of No Way Home?","answer":"Doctor Strange casts a spell that makes everyone forget Peter Parker exists, erasing his identity from the world. Peter starts over completely alone, setting up a fresh chapter for Spider-Man in the MCU."}]',
  status = 'published',
  updatedAt = NOW()
WHERE slug = 'spider-man-no-way-home-2021'
